name: Hakuto-R program
tagline: Japan's first private Moon landing attempts; Mission 1 (2023) and Mission 2 (2025) both crashed
description: Hakuto-R is a lunar lander program of the Japanese company ispace. Its Mission 1 lander, launched in December 2022, was Japan's first private attempt at a Moon landing and crashed in April 2023. The Mission 2 lander, Resilience, crashed in June 2025.
best_known_for: Japan's first private Moon landing attempts; Mission 1 (2023) and Mission 2 (2025) both crashed
